title: Identity fields in the ledger entry
goal: Ledger schema 2: each entry records model digest, runtime identity hash, scenario hash and an optional consumer source key taken from the admitted report and the record call
acceptance: `LedgerEntry` gains modelDigest, runtimeHash (hash of the report's identity and runtime), scenarioHash (environment hash or null) and sourceKey (opaque string or null)
`gauntlet ledger record --source-key=…` stores the key; the key is validated as a bounded opaque token, never a path or free text
Schema 1 ledgers still validate and are read as unknown identity; writing upgrades the file to schema 2
docs/LEDGER.md lists every identity field and what changes it
validation: Fixtures for record with and without a source key, schema 1 read and upgrade, refusal of an unbounded key; npm test
escalation: A field that could carry private content is an owner decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-11 from the v0.6.0 ledger code (one entry type, one record function). Estimate, not a measurement.

privacy: Metadata only: identities, hashes, dates; no outputs, prompts, paths or credentials.
